Frequently Asked Questions
Who can become a member of AEETDS?
Anyone interested in agriculture, allied sciences, environment, technology or rural development, in India or
abroad — including students, farmers and entrepreneurs.

Is membership required to attend a conference?
No. Non-members can register for any event. Members pay concessional fees where announced.

How do I know my abstract has been received?
You receive an automatic acknowledgement email with a reference number immediately after submission.
Acceptance is communicated by email by the date given in the brochure.

Will my abstract be published if I do not register?
No. Abstracts are published only after the registration fee is received.

When should I pay the award fee?
Only after you receive email confirmation that your award has been approved. Do not pay at the time of
nomination.

Can I present online?
Yes. AEETDS conferences are held in hybrid mode; choose the online category while registering.

Are travel and daily allowances paid?
No. The Society and organisers do not pay TA or DA to participants or awardees.

Is the registration fee refundable?
No. Registration and award contribution fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Will I get a certificate?
Yes. All registered participants receive a participation certificate; presenters receive a presentation certificate.

Is there a fee for publishing a book chapter?
No. Chapters accepted for the Society's edited volumes are published without charge.

How do I contact the Society?
Write to secretaryaeetds@gmail.com or use the Contact form. We aim to reply within three working days.


Privacy Policy
AEETDS collects only the personal information you give us through our forms — such as name, institution,
email, phone number and uploaded documents — and uses it solely to process your membership, registration,
submission, nomination or enquiry, and to inform you about Society activities. We do not sell, rent or share
your information with third parties, except with the host institution of a conference where needed to organise
the event. You may ask us to correct or delete your information by writing to secretaryaeetds@gmail.com.


Terms of Use
All content on this website, including text, logos and photographs, belongs to AEETDS or is used with
permission, and may not be reproduced for commercial purposes without written consent. By submitting
material to AEETDS, authors confirm that it is original, that all co-authors have agreed to its submission, and
that it does not infringe anyone else's rights.


Refund and Cancellation Policy
Registration fees, membership fees and award contribution fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. If
AEETDS cancels an event, registered participants will be offered a full refund or a transfer to the next event.
Payments made twice by mistake are refunded after verification, less bank charges.


Publication Ethics
AEETDS expects all authors to follow accepted standards of research and publication ethics. Plagiarism, data
fabrication, duplicate submission and improper authorship lead to rejection or withdrawal of the work. All
submissions for edited volumes are checked for similarity, and must show less than 10% similarity.


Disclaimer
The views expressed in papers, presentations and publications are those of the authors and not necessarily of
AEETDS. While we make every effort to keep information on this website accurate and current, programme
details may change; the latest brochure and notices on this website prevail.
